g.text: When input chroma keeps rising, does output chroma follow?

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #475569

g.text: The same six P3 saturation ramps, shown as coordinates rather than color swatches
A horizontal curve means chroma no longer changes; a rising curve retains chroma variation, possibly at a different rate.
